\Case{constant-and-left-alias}{
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw plot[const plot] coordinates {(2pt,5pt)(8pt,-2pt)(3pt,-2pt)};
  \draw plot[const plot mark left=false] coordinates {(2pt,5pt)(8pt,-2pt)(3pt,-2pt)};
\end{tikzpicture}}

\Case{right-repeated-and-descending}{
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw plot[const plot mark right] coordinates {(7pt,1pt)(4pt,8pt)(4pt,-2pt)(4pt,-2pt)};
\end{tikzpicture}}

\Case{middle-irregular-spacing}{
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw plot[const plot mark mid] coordinates {(-5pt,1pt)(2pt,6pt)(3pt,-1pt)(9pt,3pt)};
\end{tikzpicture}}

\Case{jump-three-sides}{
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw plot[jump mark left] coordinates {(2pt,5pt)(8pt,-2pt)(3pt,1pt)};
  \draw plot[jump mark right] coordinates {(2pt,5pt)(8pt,-2pt)(3pt,1pt)};
  \draw plot[jump mark mid] coordinates {(2pt,5pt)(8pt,-2pt)(3pt,1pt)};
\end{tikzpicture}}

\Case{first-action-and-relative-tail}{
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw (-2pt,1pt) -- plot[jump mark right] coordinates {(2pt,7pt)(8pt,1pt)} -- ++(1pt,2pt);
  \draw (-2pt,1pt) plot[jump mark right] coordinates {(2pt,7pt)(8pt,1pt)} -- ++(1pt,2pt);
\end{tikzpicture}}

\Case{file-stream-jumps}{
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=2pt,y=3pt]
  \draw (0,0) -- plot[const plot mark mid] file {observations.table} -- ++(1,1);
  \draw (0,0) -- plot[jump mark left] file {observations.table} -- ++(1,1);
\end{tikzpicture}}

\Case{rotated-and-skewed-basis}{
\begin{tikzpicture}[x={(8pt,3pt)},y={(-2pt,5pt)},rotate=90]
  \draw plot[const plot mark right] coordinates {(1,0)(2,3)(4,-2)};
  \draw plot[jump mark mid,xshift=2pt,yscale=-.5] coordinates {(1,0)(2,3)(4,-2)};
\end{tikzpicture}}

\Case{local-handler-and-restore}{
\begin{tikzpicture}[const plot]
  \begin{scope}[jump mark right]
    \draw plot coordinates {(1pt,2pt)(3pt,4pt)};
    \draw plot[/tikz/const plot mark mid] coordinates {(1pt,2pt)(3pt,4pt)};
  \end{scope}
  \draw plot coordinates {(1pt,2pt)(3pt,4pt)};
  \draw plot[const plot mark right,sharp plot] coordinates {(1pt,2pt)(3pt,4pt)};
\end{tikzpicture}}

\Case{empty-and-singleton}{
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw plot[const plot mark mid] coordinates {};
  \draw (2pt,1pt) -- plot[jump mark right] coordinates {(4pt,7pt)} -- ++(1pt,1pt);
\end{tikzpicture}}

\Case{expression-samples}{
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=2pt,y=3pt]
  \draw plot[jump mark mid,samples at={0,1,3,2}] (\x,{\x*\x});
\end{tikzpicture}}
